pearls: **CYP2D6 genotyping** needed to go to higher doses
For TD, VMAT2 inhibitors may need **>90% VMAT2 inhibition** for the best balance of efficacy and tolerability
Treats TD by **lowering dopamine** in both the go and stop pathways, with no D2 receptor blockade
VMAT1 sits on vesicles in **peripheral and central** neurons, whereas VMAT2 is **central only**, which is why reserpine, unlike tetrabenazine-type drugs, has frequent peripheral effects
Does not help **akathisia** much and may worsen **tardive dystonia**
Works best for parkinsonism from **older D2 blockers** lacking serotonergic actions
**IM anticholinergic** nearly always relieves acute dystonia within about 20 minutes
Many patients on D2 blockers carry too much **anticholinergic burden**: consider a D2 blocker without anticholinergic action, stopping the anticholinergic, or switching to amantadine
Know the picture it treats: NMS brings extreme **rigidity, high fever and coma** and can be fatal; some see it as the extreme end of DIP
Of the co-therapies for weight gain, **topiramate** has less consistent results than metformin
Co-therapy may also help prevent **dyslipidemia** (raised only as a possibility)
Described only as a partner for **olanzapine**, aimed at weight gain and metabolic disturbance rather than psychosis
